states.name: EXTEND
states.description: Slide extend command active; waits for ExtendDone.

states.name: CLAMP
states.description: Clamp command active; waits for ClampDone.

states.name: RELEASE
states.description: Release command active; waits for ReleaseDone.

states.name: RETRACT
states.description: Slide retract command active; waits for RetractDone.

states.name: DONE
states.description: Cycle complete. Holds until Stop or Reset.

transitions.notes: Safety override. At most one transition per scan.

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND Start AND RetractDone
transitions.action: enter EXTEND; post-transition outputs use EXTEND

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND ExtendDone
transitions.action: enter CLAMP; post-transition outputs use CLAMP

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND ClampDone
transitions.action: enter RELEASE; post-transition outputs use RELEASE

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND ReleaseDone
transitions.action: enter RETRACT; post-transition outputs use RETRACT

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND RetractDone
transitions.action: enter DONE; post-transition outputs use DONE

transitions.guard: NOT Stop AND NOT Reset AND matching completion feedback is FALSE
transitions.action: hold active stage and continue commanding its actuator

notes: State evaluation uses retained pre-scan state q[k].
Only one normal state transition may execute per scan; Stop/Reset abort overrides all transitions.
Outputs O[k] are assigned from the post-transition state at end of scan, except abort always forces IDLE/all-off outputs.
No edge-based transitions are required; all handshake inputs are level-sensitive.

timer_plan.stage_3_timer_calls: No unconditional timer FB calls; stage 3 is a no-op
timer_plan.notes: No timeout is included. Missing completion handshakes intentionally stall the active step indefinitely until Stop/Reset.

safety: Stop OR Reset has highest priority and forces IDLE with all outputs FALSE.
Stop/Reset override any simultaneous Start, handshake, or active-stage transition.
At most one state transition per scan invocation.
Actuator commands Extend, Clamp, Release, Retract are mutually exclusive.
Busy is TRUE exactly when one of the four active commands is TRUE; Busy and Done are mutually exclusive.
operational: Sample all inputs once at the start of each scan.
Evaluate safety/reset before normal sequence transitions.
Normal transitions advance only on matching level-sensitive completion feedback.
IDLE to EXTEND requires Start TRUE and RetractDone TRUE.
DONE holds until Stop or Reset; Start does not restart from DONE without clear.
Outputs are computed from the final post-transition state in the same scan.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Sample every declared input exactly once and retain the scan-local values.
No edge-dependent behavior is used by this specification; level-sensitive values are used by later stages.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: If Stop OR Reset is TRUE, force state := IDLE and mark all commands cleared; do not evaluate normal transitions.
Else evaluate exactly one normal transition using retained pre-scan state q[k] and sampled inputs.
If no transition condition is met, retain q[k] unchanged for the next scan.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls
actions: No timer function blocks are required.
This stage executes unconditionally but contains no timer calls.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
actions: Assign Extend, Clamp, Release, Retract, Busy, and Done from the final post-transition state.
If Stop or Reset was TRUE in stage 2, all outputs are forced FALSE.
Use a single output section so every output reflects the same scan-final state.

formal_assertions.formula: G(!(Extend & Clamp) & !(Extend & Release) & !(Extend & Retract) & !(Clamp & Release) & !(Clamp & Retract) & !(Release & Retract))
